profile.description: Whisper v3 Large is a state-of-the-art automatic speech recognition and translation model developed by OpenAI, offering 10–20% lower error rates than its predecessor, Whisper large-v2. It supports transcription and translation across numerous languages, with improvements in handling diverse audio inputs, including noisy conditions and long-form audio files.
